verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote as the dominant, readable element in a left-to-right banner flow, but the quote sits tight against the left and bottom edges, the attribution floats mid-height beside it instead of under it, and the logo is enlarged and crammed against the product circle. B makes the logo a huge centered header that outranks a now-small quote, shrinks the attribution and product until they barely register, and leaves a wide empty strip on the left, so the hierarchy is inverted.
